targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ Wrong 6 out of 10 times and still profitable? Here's how 👇
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Win rate vs risk-reward for beginners: how a trader can lose 6 out of 10 trades and still make a profit in intraday trading, and why one reckless trade can wipe out everything.
Many beginners believe they need a high win rate to be profitable. In reality, profit depends on risk-reward and position size, not just how often you win. A trader who wins only 4 out of 10 trades can still make money if the winners are bigger than the losers. But one reckless trade with your whole account can erase months of progress. Trading Ki Asli Chaabi 🔑 | Risk Management, Stop Loss & Discipline!

Want to become a better trader? Understand the three most important pillars of trading.

Many beginners focus only on finding the perfect entry, but professional trading requires much more than that.

🔑 3 IMPORTANT PILLARS OF TRADING:

1️⃣ RISK MANAGEMENT
Protect your capital and decide how much you are willing to risk before entering a trade.

Always define your exit and acceptable loss. Never remove your stop loss emotionally.
